td.p: You authorize YourCompany to debit the bank account identified above for the amounts specified on any outstanding Invoices or Sales Orders linked to your account. Debits will occur automatically on the due date specified on each document, or the next business day. You confirm you have authority over this account. If no end date is specified, you will have to contact us to stop its use. Delivery of the individual Invoice or Sales Order via email at least 10 calendar days prior to the withdrawal.
